briefings.title: Yann LeCun lève 1 milliard de dollars avec AMI Labs - Tech&Co la quotidienne du 10/03/2026
briefings.tldr: Yann LeCun’s new startup, AMI Labs, has secured a record-breaking $1 billion seed round to develop "World Models" that move beyond current LLM limitations, while the French telecom market braces for a massive consolidation as Orange, Bouygues, and Free move to dismantle and acquire SFR.
